title: Constrained linear chirp MgF2/HfO2 stack with tight variance bounds
scientific_hypothesis: A constrained linear chirp trajectory (thickness decaying from ~140 nm to ~50 nm across 20 layers) with strict per-layer variance bounds (±5 nm) will suppress large-amplitude stochastic jumps and guide the optimizer toward a physically meaningful manifold, improving target score convergence compared to the unconstrained chirp in route_02.
design_principle: Initialize thickness variables on a smooth linear chirp path and apply tight bounds to restrict search to a narrow manifold around this trajectory, reducing optimizer exploration of non-physical thickness combinations while preserving optimization freedom within the manifold.
proposed_topology: Air | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | MgF2 | HfO2 | fused silica substrate (20 finite layers total, alternating MgF2/HfO2 starting with MgF2)
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 255-280 nm band
minimize mean transmittance in 300-700 nm band
minimize mean transmittance in 700-1100 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: tight thickness tolerance (±5 nm) requires precise deposition control
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for multilayer interference
expected_advantages: Tighter bounds reduce search space and improve convergence
Linear chirp initialization provides physically meaningful starting point
May achieve higher target score than route_02's unconstrained approach
known_risks: Tight bounds may prevent optimizer from finding global optimum if chirp trajectory is suboptimal
20 layers may be insufficient for simultaneous 300-700 nm and 700-1100 nm rejection
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer alternating MgF2/HfO2 stack on fused silica substrate under air incidence. Layer sequence: MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2, MgF2, HfO2 (20 finite layers). Initialize thicknesses on a linear chirp from 140 nm (layer 1) to 50 nm (layer 20). Apply per-layer thickness bounds of ±5 nm around the chirp trajectory. Optimize all 20 thicknesses to maximize mean transmittance in 255-280 nm while minimizing mean transmittance in 300-700 nm and 700-1100 nm bands. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Evaluate coherent TMM response across 255-1100 nm spectrum. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 255-280 nm, 300-700 nm, 700-1100 nm. soft objectives: high transmittance in 255–280 nm; low transmittance in 300–700 nm; low transmittance in 700–1100 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 300–700 nm; transmittance in 700–1100 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layers ≤ 30; no metal layers; conventional depositable inorganic dielectric materials only.
revision_reason: Direct response to feedback directives: implement constrained linear chirp trajectory with tight per-layer variance bounds (±5 nm) to suppress large-amplitude stochastic jumps observed in route_02 and force optimizer into physically meaningful search manifold.
